caption:
Lulu changes nappies many times a day, and lately her lower back aches every time she straightens up.

When the change table is too low, you can end up bending deeply over and over. Setting it to around waist height and standing close may help share the load on your back.

Hybi's tip: keep wipes and nappies within reach, soften your knees as you lean in, and always keep one hand on bub.

Pain or tingling down a leg, or back pain that wakes you, is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD chiropractors can help. Book online via the link in bio
